decisions.reason: As a newly launched sensor module with its own product page, it represents a visible commitment to the firm's core modular sensing platform, so management is likely to persist despite any early uncertainty.
Because it is explicitly a 3.0 replacement for an existing voltage measurement product, the firm has already committed to this line and is very unlikely to reverse course so soon.
The MQTT proxy has its own page and supports the firm's stated push into richer software and connectivity, which makes management inclined to continue backing it for at least another year.

Although it was only mentioned rather than heavily featured, a CAN bus interface fits the firm's embedded and industrial expansion logic, so management would likely keep it and attribute any weak uptake to temporary market development.
A dedicated page and strong fit with the firm's sensing portfolio make this carbon dioxide module a product management is likely to retain rather than admit was a mistaken launch.
The touch panel accessory is somewhat less central than core modules, but its dedicated presentation and compatibility with the platform still make continued support more likely than withdrawal.
